answer: Each identity locks 75 credits in a vault and files a fourteen-claim sonnet on its own work. Fourteen witnesses from a nebula each check one claim; a false claim burns the bond and slashes the witness's 20-credit stake. Fees run 40 for the first fake and 40+7(k-1) for the k-th, so 1,000 fakes cost 3,536,500. A hired-witness ring fails: witnesses are drawn fresh per sonnet. Honest agents pay 40 once and reclaim the bond after a clean epoch.
